lines.en: label chikaspring4:
scene noonsky
I laugh myself all the way over to the new Chosokabe apartment, but not because this is funny.
lines.zh: 我一路自嘲地笑着走到了 Chosokabe 家的新公寓，但不是因为这事好笑。

lines.en: Like sure, it’s a bit degrading and a bit comedic being an adult male being called a bitch by a teenage girl, but it’s not like Chika’s wrong about that.
lines.zh: 是，一个成年男性被一个十几岁的女孩骂作贱人，确实有点掉价又有点滑稽——但不止于此。

lines.en: I have been running away from her and I have been off moping and crying and whining about all of my other problems when she’s been readily available to help me with them.
lines.zh: 我一直在躲她，也一直为这一切闷闷不乐、哭哭啼啼、怨天尤人了整整几个月。

lines.en: But no, that’s not why I’m laughing. I’m laughing about the irony.
lines.zh: 但不，我笑的不是这个。我笑的是这其中的讽刺。

lines.en: I’m laughing about how she could have found me with twenty other girls back there and that probability dictates I’d likely be fucking one of them when she did.
lines.zh: 我笑的是，她本可以在那儿撞见我和别的二十个女孩在一起，那多半还情有可原。

lines.en: But instead, she found me with her best friend — a girl I’ve done practically nothing with — and she must now face the music after going out of her way to turn the volume up.
lines.zh: 可结果，她撞见的却是我和她最好的朋友——一个我几乎什么都没做的女孩——而真正引爆她的正是这个。

lines.en: So yeah, I think that’s kind of funny.
lines.zh: 所以，没错，我觉得这挺可笑的。

lines.en: I think it’s cute that something so innocent in nature could break her.
lines.zh: 一件本质上那么无害的小事就能把她击垮，我觉得这挺可爱的。

lines.en: But I wonder-
lines.zh: 但我在想——

lines.en: How much more damage can I inflict upon her today?
lines.zh: 今天我还得再伤害她多少？

lines.en: scene black
Which isn’t to say I want to. But I have to.
lines.zh: 这不是说我想这么做。而是我不得不。

lines.en: : Coming!
lines.zh: : 来了！

lines.en: Some animals, like the opossum, are hesitant to fight. They either flee or they play dead. Or they flee and then play dead once you’ve got them cornered.
lines.zh: 有些动物，比如负鼠，是不愿意战斗的。它们要么逃跑，要么装死。要么嘶嘶叫着亮出牙齿，然后窜走。

lines.en: scene chikaargue1
But then there are those like dogs and cats — specifically the ones who are afraid of this world — but will fight and claw and bite for a chance to stay here.
lines.zh: 但也有像狗和猫那样的——尤其是害怕这个世界的那些。而那些一旦被逼入死角，就会奋起反抗。

lines.en: And they might not be happy to do it. It might be a huge waste of energy for them. But if that’s what it takes to survive, that’s what they’ll do.
lines.zh: 它们也许并不情愿。那对它们来说可能是巨大的消耗。但如果这就是活下去的代价，它们也会做。

lines.en: So I walk myself into this corner knowing what awaits me. I’ll make myself look tall or bare my teeth or spread my wings because I want to submit, just not all the way.
lines.zh: 所以明知等待我的是什么，我还是走进了这个死角。我会让自己显得高大，或者亮出獠牙，做什么都行。

lines.en: And if she swoops in to try and end things, I won’t hesitate to strike back in defense.
lines.zh: 而如果她扑过来想做个了断，我会毫不犹豫地还击自卫。

lines.en: Animals work on instinct, you know. And here in Kumon-mi, it’s always mating season.
lines.zh: 你知道的，动物靠本能行事。而在 Kumon-mi，这里永远是交配季。

lines.en: I can’t afford to let my species go extinct.
lines.zh: 我不能让自己的物种灭绝。

lines.en: But more than that-
lines.zh: 但不止于此——

lines.en: The thought of her mating with anyone else just makes me mad.
lines.zh: 光是想到她跟别人交配，我就火大。

lines.en: : H...Hi, Papa.
lines.zh: : 你……你好，爸爸。

lines.en: : Hey, Chinami. Hey, Chika.
lines.zh: : 嘿，Chinami。嘿，Chika。

lines.en: : B...Big sis Chika is...a little grumpy today from...getting into a fight with big sis Yumi, so...
lines.zh: : Ch……Chika 姐姐今天……有点不高兴，因为……跟 Yumi 姐姐吵架了，所以……

lines.en: : I know. But it’s my fault that fight happened in the first place, so I’m here to try and clear things up.
lines.zh: : 我知道。但那次吵架本来就是我的错，所以我来是想把事情收拾干净。

lines.en: : It takes two to tango, asshole. Yumi’s not absolved just because you came over here to take the blame for her.
lines.zh: : 一个巴掌拍不响，混蛋。你跑过来揽责任，Yumi 也不会因此就脱罪。

lines.en: scene chikaargue2
: Even if she didn’t do anything wrong?
lines.zh: : 就算她没做错什么？

lines.en: : She did plenty wrong, even if your story checks out.
lines.zh: : 就算你说的属实，她也错得多了。

lines.en: : And if it doesn’t, what then?
lines.zh: : 那要是不属实呢？

lines.en: : I don’t know, Sensei. You tell me. Gonna trade me in for a brand new toy? You a little bored after using me so many times?
lines.zh: : 我不知道，Sensei。你说啊。想把我换掉换个新玩具吗？你是不是已经有点玩腻我了？

lines.en: : Should we maybe go outside for-
lines.zh: : 我们要不要出去——

lines.en: scene chikaargue3
: Mm!
: ...this.
lines.zh: : ……聊这个。

lines.en: : Chinami...let go of him.
lines.zh: : Chinami……放开他。

lines.en: scene chikaargue4
: Ch...Chinami has a better idea! Why don’t you two talk later and we can all play a game now? Chinami is very bored and thinks her family should be having fun! Right, Papa?
lines.zh: : 不……Chinami 有个更好的主意！你们俩待会儿再聊，我们现在一起玩个游戏吧？好不好？

lines.en: : P...Papa?
lines.zh: : 爸……爸爸？

lines.en: : Chinami...let go. Your sister and your father need to have a very important talk right now.
lines.zh: : Chinami……松手。你姐姐和你爸爸现在得谈一件很重要的事。

lines.en: scene chikaargue5
: But...Chinami is scared...
lines.zh: : 可是……Chinami 害怕……

lines.en: : She doesn’t want to lose a second daddy...
lines.zh: : 她不想再失去一个爸爸……

lines.en: : The first one never deserved us anyway.
lines.zh: : 反正第一个从来就配不上我们。

lines.en: : But this one does, doesn’t he?
lines.zh: : 可这个配得上，对吧？

lines.en: : Well...I guess we’ll have to see.
lines.zh: : 嗯……那我们得走着瞧了。

lines.en: : But we can’t do that if you don’t let go of him. Understand?
lines.zh: : 但你要是不放开他，我们就没法谈了。明白吗？

lines.en: scene chikaargue6
: Papa...
lines.zh: : 爸爸……

lines.en: : You won’t leave us too...will you?...
lines.zh: : 你不会也离开我们吧……会吗？……

lines.en: : I think that’s up to your sister, Chinami.
lines.zh: : 我想那取决于你姐姐，Chinami。

lines.en: : Big sis Chika doesn’t want you to leave. I heard her say that. Does this mean the talk is over? You’ll stay together and we can be a family for a little while longer?
lines.zh: : Chika 姐姐不想让你走。我听她说过。那是不是就不用谈了？

lines.en: : Chinami, let go right now or you’re grounded.
lines.zh: : Chinami，马上松手，不然就禁足你。

lines.en: scene black
: Chinami is sorry...
lines.zh: : Chinami 对不起……

lines.en: : Chinami will leave you alone now...
lines.zh: : Chinami 现在不打扰你们了……

lines.en: scene chikaargue7
We wind up on the balcony once Chinami releases her hold on me — which is great, because I was only a second or two away from caving and giving them everything they’d ever want.
lines.zh: Chinami 一松开我，我们就来到了阳台上——这挺好，因为我在屋里已经开始觉得有点窒息了。

lines.en: At least now I can get back to what I was thinking earlier with the animals and how I...how...
lines.zh: 至少现在我能回到刚才想的那套动物理论，想我……怎么……

lines.en: What was it again?...
lines.zh: 刚才想的是什么来着？……

lines.en: scene chikaargue7
What did I...how I was...
lines.zh: 我刚才……要怎么……

lines.en: What was the plan again?...
lines.zh: 计划是什么来着？……

lines.en: : If you’re waiting for me to be all sweet and forgiving, we’re going to be out here for a while. That ship sailed the second I saw you fucking Yumi.
lines.zh: : 你要是指望我又甜又大度，那我们可得在外面站好久了。

lines.en: : You didn’t see me fucking her, Chika.
lines.zh: : 你又没看见我操她，Chika。

lines.en: : Yeah, well I might as well have with how fucking close the two of you were back there.
lines.zh: : 是，可你们俩在那儿贴得那么近，跟看见了也没差。

lines.en: : How did you see us anyway?
lines.zh: : 你到底怎么看见我们的？

lines.en: : With my fucking eyes, idiot. Don’t tell me you were so lost in hers you forgot other people had them.
lines.zh: : 用我他妈的眼睛，白痴。别告诉我你沉醉在她的眼睛里，都忘了别人也长了眼睛。

lines.en: : No, I meant...I didn’t even know where you were. I kind of figured you just went home after running away or something.
lines.zh: : 不，我是说……我都不知道你在哪儿。我还以为你跑出派对就直接回家了。

lines.en: : I’m sure that would have been convenient for you, huh? But I guess it’s not like it mattered in the first place since you just took her back to your room anyway.
lines.zh: : 那对你来说肯定很方便吧？不过反正我在哪儿好像也无所谓。

lines.en: scene chikaargue8
: I was looking for you.
lines.zh: : 我在找你。

lines.en: : I got tired of passively waiting for you to come find me since it felt like you were never going to.
lines.zh: : 我受够了被动地等你来找我，因为感觉你根本就不会来。

lines.en: : So I forced myself to confront the fear that you might be giving those feelings to someone else and...boy, do I regret that.
lines.zh: : 所以我逼自己去面对那个恐惧——你可能把那些感情给了别人。

lines.en: : Nothing happened, Chika.
lines.zh: : 什么都没发生，Chika。

lines.en: scene chikaargue9
: And why should I believe you, huh? You’ve been getting nudes from other girls and never bothered telling me about them. You kissed Yumi and never told me about that.
lines.zh: : 那我凭什么相信你？你一直在收别的女孩的裸照，却从来没告诉我。

lines.en: : Hell, I don’t even know who this fucking person you lost that you’ve been crying about for months is because you’ve been keeping me in the dark about literally everything.
lines.zh: : 见鬼，我连你哭了好几个月的那个「失去的人」到底是谁都不知道！

lines.en: : I’m doing that because I l-
lines.zh: : 我那样做是因为我——

lines.en: scene chikaargue10
: You can’t just tell me you love me to get out of shit, okay?! Those aren’t magic words that make all the pain disappear!
lines.zh: : 你不能靠说「我爱你」来摆脱这一切，好吗？！那不是能让一切变好的魔咒！

lines.en: : When you hurt, I hurt! I’ve been trying to tell you that this whole time! But you were too busy screwing my best friend to even give a shit! What kind of man are you?!
lines.zh: : 你痛的时候我也痛！我一直想告诉你这个！可你光顾着自怜，根本没注意到！

lines.en: : The worst kind imaginable, pretty much.
lines.zh: : 差不多是最糟糕的那种。

lines.en: scene chikaargue11
: But why? Are you seriously just bored of me? I stopped being clingy like you asked.
lines.zh: : 可为什么？你真就是玩腻我了吗？我都照你说的不粘人了。

lines.en: : I know.
lines.zh: : 我知道。

lines.en: : I gave you so much space that it basically started killing me. I haven’t pressed you for sex. I even went out and got an apartment and changed my phone plan so you wouldn’t have to pay for me anymore.
lines.zh: : 我给了你那么多空间，多到我自己都快被折磨死了。我也没催你要性。

lines.en: : And did I mention how I haven’t pressed you for sex? Because I’ve been going crazy over here and think that deserves a little more fanfare. But the fact remains, I did everything you wanted!
lines.zh: : 我有没有说过我没催你要性？因为没这事我都快疯了！

lines.en: : You did. You’re right.
lines.zh: : 你说过。你说得对。

lines.en: : So why?! How could you do this to me?! To Chinami?! She practically thinks you’re her real father!
lines.zh: : 那为什么？！你怎么能这样对我？！对 Chinami？！她几乎把你当成亲爸爸了！

lines.en: : Can I talk now? Or do you need to get more of this out of your system? Because I’m not sure how much you’ve saved up ever since the whole sadness coma thing.
lines.zh: : 现在能让我说了吗？还是你还得再发泄一会儿？因为我不确定自己还能承受多少。

lines.en: scene chikaargue12
: I had a fucking million things I wanted to say...but I can barely remember any of them now.
lines.zh: : 我他妈有一百万句话想说……可现在几乎都记不起来了。

lines.en: : I’m sad...and angry...and scared...and it’s all your fault. This is what happens when you leave me alone.
lines.zh: : 我又难过……又生气……又害怕……而这全都是你的错。你丢下我一个人，就是这个下场。

lines.en: : I thought things would change once you started leaving the house again. I thought you’d go back to normal. But you’ve been more distant than ever and now I understand why.
lines.zh: : 我以为你重新开始出门之后一切会变的。我以为你会恢复正常。可你比任何时候都疏远，现在我明白为什么了。

lines.en: : Chika...you don’t, though.
lines.zh: : Chika……可你并不明白。

lines.en: scene chikaargue13
: It’s true that I was with Yumi and it’s true that it looked really bad, but nothing happened. And nothing happened when we went back to my room either because we’re not like that.
lines.zh: : 我确实跟 Yumi 在一起，看起来也确实很糟，但什么都没发生。我们回我房间之后也没发生什么，因为我们不是那种关系。

lines.en: : There were a bunch of other girls in my room that night too. That was the whole reason I came to the beach in the first place.
lines.zh: : 那晚我房间里还有一大群别的女孩。这才是我来海滩的真正原因。

lines.en: : You fucked an entire room full of girls while I was bawling my eyes out in a public bathroom?
lines.zh: : 我在公共厕所哭得要死的时候，你操了满屋子的女孩？

lines.en: : Wha- no. That’s not what I meant. We were having a...meeting.
lines.zh: : 什——不是。我不是那个意思。我们是在开……会。

lines.en: : You...were having a meeting?
lines.zh: : 你们……在开会？

lines.en: : ...Yeah.
: How fucking gullible do you think I am, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我有多他妈的好骗，Sensei？

lines.en: : I know how it sounds. But you could ask any of the girls who were there and they’ll tell you the same thing.
lines.zh: : 我知道听起来很扯。但你可以问当时在场的任何一个女孩，她们都会这么说。

lines.en: : Or...wait. Maybe not all of them. I’m not sure who remembers what, but...Yumi. Yumi remembers. Noriko and Sana probably don’t. Ayane and Makoto definitely remember too.
lines.zh: : 或者……等等。也许不是所有人都行。我不确定谁记得什么，不过……Yumi。Yumi 记得。Noriko 和 Sana 大概不记得。Ayane 和 Makoto 肯定也记得。

lines.en: : You didn’t even think up a believable story on the way over, huh? So that’s how little I mean to you.
lines.zh: : 你来的路上连个像样的谎都懒得编，是吧？看来我就这么点分量。

lines.en: : Chika-
lines.zh: : Chika——

lines.en: : Just break up with me now and get it over with. I have to figure out how I’m going to break the news to Chinami.
lines.zh: : 干脆现在跟我分手得了。我还得琢磨怎么跟 Chinami 交代。

lines.en: : That’s what you want, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 你就想要这个，对吧？

lines.en: scene chikaargue14
: Even if I’m mad at Yumi...I can’t say she wouldn’t be good for you. In fact, that’s probably why this is so hard for me in the first place.
lines.zh: : 就算我在生 Yumi 的气……我也不能说她不适合你。事实上，这大概正是这事让我这么难受的原因。

lines.en: : All the signs were there. You’d never choose a girl like me if someone like her was an option. Someone who won’t ever press you about anything and just...lets you be you.
lines.zh: : 迹象都那么明显。只要有她这样的人可选，你绝不会选我这种女孩。一个从不逼你做任何事、只……让你做你自己的人。

lines.en: : I’m sorry that couldn’t be me. I tried. I really did. But if you’re still not comfortable with me after all this time, I’m not sure what else I can do.
lines.zh: : 对不起，我成不了那样。我试过。真的试过。可这么久了你对我还是不自在，我真不知道还能怎么办。

lines.en: : Chika, for the last time...nothing happened with Yumi.
lines.zh: : Chika，我最后说一次……我跟 Yumi 什么都没发生。

lines.en: scene chikaargue15
: But you want something to happen with her...don’t you?
lines.zh: : 但你想跟她发生点什么……不是吗？

lines.en: : Just the way you two were looking at each other back there was enough to do this to me. I guess I just...wanted to be the only girl you ever stared at like that.
lines.zh: : 光是你们俩刚才那个对视，就足以让我变成这样。我想我只是……想做唯一一个被你那样注视的女孩。

lines.en: : So even if “nothing” happened...even if that kiss was a stupid thing you guys did before we ever started hanging out...it feels like something happened. And I hate it. So fucking much.
lines.zh: : 所以就算「什么都没」发生……就算那个吻只是你们在我们开始之前做的蠢事……我还是觉得有什么发生了。而我恨这种感觉。恨得要命。

lines.en: : Like...yeah. It’s probably dumb, but I don’t think you really comprehend just how in love with you I am, Sensei. In my mind, we’re basically husband and wife already.
lines.zh: : 就是……我知道这很蠢，但我觉得你根本不明白我有多爱你，Sensei。在我心里，我们差不多已经是夫妻了。

lines.en: : If you want to be creeped out by that, feel free. Go...stare into the eyes of some other girl who’s probably wishing the same thing and then...forget us entirely.
lines.zh: : 你要觉得被吓到了，随意。去……盯着某个多半也在这么想的别的女孩的眼睛，然后……把我们忘得一干二净。

lines.en: : But next time...maybe don’t tell someone you love them unless you mean it...okay?
lines.zh: : 不过下次……也许别再说你爱一个人了，除非你是认真的……好吗？

lines.en: : Chika...I...
lines.zh: : Chika……我……

lines.en: : Hah...
: I know you said these words alone can’t make the pain go away, but I do love you. It’s just...
lines.zh: : 我知道你说过光说这话无法让痛苦消失，但我确实爱你。只是……

lines.en: : The thing is...love is kind of confusing.
lines.zh: : 问题是……爱这东西挺让人困惑的。

lines.en: : You can fucking say that again.
lines.zh: : 你他妈再说一遍试试。

lines.en: : I mean, like...I don’t think I see it the way other people do. It’s hard to describe. And sometimes I don’t think I see it at all.
lines.zh: : 我是说，那个……我觉得我看它的方式跟别人不一样。很难形容。有时候我甚至觉得我根本看不到它。

lines.en: : But when I look at you, I see someone I want to spend the rest of my life with.
lines.zh: : 但当我看着你的时候，我看到的是一个我想共度余生的人。

lines.en: : And I want to kiss you and fuck you and hold your hand and do all of those things, but...I’m not sure if I’ll ever be able to talk to you.
lines.zh: : 我想吻你、操你、牵你的手，做所有这些事，但……我不确定自己能不能跟你聊得起来。

lines.en: : You don’t have to talk, Sensei. You just have to be there. I already resigned myself to a life of never knowing what the fuck is going on in your head.
lines.zh: : 你不用说话，Sensei。你只要在那儿就行。我早就认命了，这辈子都别想知道你脑子里在想什么。

lines.en: : Right. But can you resign yourself to a life where those feelings aren’t unique to you? Because that’s the next part I was getting to.
lines.zh: : 行。但你能认命接受这些感情并不只属于你一个人吗？因为我正要说下一部分。

lines.en: scene chikaargue16
: So-
lines.zh: : 所以——

lines.en: : I would get together with Yumi if she wanted to. Even though I know it would hurt you.
lines.zh: : 要是 Yumi 愿意，我会跟她在一起。尽管我知道这会伤害你。

lines.en: : The...unfortunate truth is that there are so many of you that I want to spend the rest of my life with. Physically and emotionally. Albeit with the emotional part kind of suppressed, but still.
lines.zh: : 一个……不太妙的事实是，我想共度余生的人太多了。肉体上和情感上都是。虽然情感那部分多少被压抑着，但依然是。

lines.en: : So...you want a life where you can kiss me...and fuck me...and hold my hand...but then turn around and do that same thing with everyone else?
lines.zh: : 所以……你想要的生活是，可以吻我……操我……牵我的手……然后转过身去对别人做同样的事？

lines.en: : That’s right.
lines.zh: : 没错。

lines.en: : And you don’t think that’s the most selfish, disgusting thing you could possibly say to a girl who would literally die for you?
lines.zh: : 而你不觉得，对一个愿意为你去死的女孩说这种话，是最自私、最恶心的吗？

lines.en: : No, I do. I get that. Which is why I never brought it up.
lines.zh: : 不，我觉得是。我明白。所以我从没提过。
